title: Credit and Collections Terms for Electric Service by Rate Schedule
content:
**Electric Service by Rate Schedule — collection terms by schedule.** The cooperative's disconnect notice thresholds, notice timing, pledge hold, field collection fee, business hours and finaling period are fixed per schedule:

| Term | R | RS | FH | GS-1 | GS-3 | IR | LP |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Smallest past-due amount for which a disconnect notice is issued | $50.00 | $50.00 | $50.00 | $100.00 | $100.00 | $150.00 | $500.00 |
| Calendar days after the due date on which the notice is issued | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 3 |
| Calendar days from the notice date to the earliest permitted disconnection | 10 | 10 | 10 | 7 | 7 | 7 | 5 |
| Disconnection for nonpayment permitted on a Friday | No | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Calendar days an energy assistance pledge holds disconnection | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Field collection fee | $35.00 | $35.00 | $35.00 | $35.00 | $35.00 | $35.00 | $50.00 |
| Business hours start (weekdays that are not cooperative holidays) | 08:00 | 08:00 | 08:00 | 08:00 | 08:00 | 08:00 | 08:00 |
| Business hours end | 16:30 | 16:30 | 16:30 | 16:30 | 16:30 | 16:30 | 16:30 |
| Calendar days disconnected for nonpayment before the account is final billed | 21 | 21 | 21 | 14 | 14 | 30 | 10 |

Column key: R is Schedule R Residential Service; RS is Schedule RS Seasonal Residential Service; FH is Schedule FH Farm and Home Service; GS-1 is Schedule GS-1 Single-Phase General Service; GS-3 is Schedule GS-3 Three-Phase General Service; IR is Schedule IR Irrigation Service; LP is Schedule LP Large Power Service.

### Notes

- The residential and farm schedules (R, RS, FH) give the longest notice period, 10 calendar days, and do not permit disconnection on a Friday. Schedules GS-1, GS-3 and IR give 7 calendar days and Schedule LP 5; those four permit Friday disconnection.
- The notice is issued 5 calendar days after the due date on every schedule except Schedule LP, where it is issued 3 calendar days after it.
- An energy assistance pledge holds disconnection for 30 calendar days from the date it is recorded on every schedule.
- The field collection fee is $35.00, or $50.00 on Schedule LP. Business hours are 08:00 to 16:30 local time on all schedules.
- The finaling period is 21 calendar days on Schedules R, RS and FH, 14 on GS-1 and GS-3, 30 on IR and 10 on LP.

### Hypothetical example

A Schedule GS-1 account with a past-due amount of $85.00 is below that schedule's $100.00 notice threshold; the same $85.00 on a Schedule R account is above the $50.00 threshold.
